content: Hayakyak Makromon ken patal Yesus
Lere Yesus namhara oir wauwau Yordan onne, Roh Kudus minle Ai raramne la norkaru Ai laa noho mamun ma napro'uk.
Min lolo onne Hayakyak Makromon man kene patal Yesus lere weli'akka raram. Lelere a'alam ka na'an haida de rakan alam weli'akka horu, Ai namlara wake'e.
Enime'ede Hayakyak Makromon mai ne'el Ai na'ahenia, “Lo'o namlolo kokkoo Makromod Lalap Anan O, hopon waku eni namwali hanana'an.”
Enimaa Yesus walhe na'ahenia, “Makromod Lalap na'aheniyedi lolo Horok Lap raram, ‘Ri kan mori nano hanana'an mehe.’ ”
Horu ne, Hayakyak Makromon nodi Yesus laa wo'or man kulu rehi. Me'e'eni me'ede an kukul Yesus noho wawan nin hair-hair na'akeme.

Ai ne'el Yesus na'aheni, “Ya ala hair-hair noro rir linikir kanaru na'akeme ki O leke modi molollo. Ainu'u molollo aile hi'i onne ono ha wo'ira na'akeme onne raledi ya'u me'e de ya ale inhoi-inhoi menmolollo ainu'u suke.
Ende ya ala ha wo'ira na'akeme onne Om manarne horo nahenia O ma'uli masa'a ya'u nanu.”
Enimaa Yesus walha na'ahenia, “Horhorok aile man hopon Makromod Lalap Nin ri na'ahenia, ‘Ma'uli masa'a Makrommu, Makromod Lalap, la derne makani Ai mehe.’ ”
Onne horu, Hayakyak Makromon nodi Ai laa kota Yerusalem laa onno man kulu wake'e lolo Makromod Lalap Nin Romleu Lape, la na'aheni, “Lo'o namlolo kokkoo Makromod Lalap Ananne O, nehu laa yawa,
ono horhorok aile Horok Lapeni ma na'ahenia,

content.text: ‘Makromod Lalap hopon Nin hophopon a'am raram mai leke radiyaka O wawa'an.
Hir mai kokala O leke yon mediyawa la yon eum tukul wakue.’ ”

content: Yesus walha na'ahenia, “Maa horhorok aile haenhi man hopon Makromod Lalap Nin ri na'ahenia, ‘Yon hi'i ha ma kan min haida modi kene Makromod Lalap Ma Narehi Ma Nalewen.’ ”
Hayakyak Makromon nodi kalla wo'ira kene patal Yesus horu ne, an hoikaruwedi Yesus la lapan leken paharin wali'ur.
Kame'ede Yesus wali laa Galilea la Roh Kudus na'aromromo raramne de Nin ke'eke'el an'anha norle'ule'u norwaliwali Ai mamani. Yesus naran pe'eredi lolo noho onne na'akeme.
An wakuku lolo Yahudi rir kerei-kerei la ri na'akeme ra'uli Ai.
Manin Nazaret ra'okul Yesus

Enime'ede Yesus wali laa Nin leke Nazaret. (Nano tatana rakan lapa, Ai noro Nin ri leleher minle leke onne.) Rakanedi Yahudi nin Alam Renren Warwarna, An laa Yahudi rir kerei raram naisa nadedem. Ai namriri leke lese Horok Lape,
la hi rala nabi Yesaya nin horok An lese. An hari horok lunlunna onne nanoin lisar ida woro'o leke lese heri kalarna. Lisar onne lirna na'ahenia,

content.text: “Makromod Lalap Nin Roh aile Maya'u raram, ono Ai na'onedi Maya'u leke aderre adaul Lirna Wawa'an laa ri ma na'alehe haida-haida.
Makromod Lalap hopon Ya'u mai kukunohi Lirna Wawa'an onne laa ri ma aile kali wunuku dadal rai raram, leke hi rahinuri rawine'eredi.
An hopon Ya'u mai leke hi'i man makan toko wa'anedi la huri we'er ri man aile kenerne danalha raram.
An hopon Ya aderre adaul Ai Lirna ma na'ahenia lere alam man An kukul Nin rere'e haharu ri mormori rakanedi me'e.”

content: Lese horu, Yesus lunne horok onne wali'ur, nala kanile wali'ur laa man howok kerei onne la naikoredi leke wakuku kerei raramne. Man penpenu kerei raram onnenihe po'on kakane.
Enime'ede An kukunohi hi na'ahenia, “Lere eniyeni Horok Lap Lirna man mim dederne idedi eni namwaliyedi me'e!”

Heri man derne Ainina wanakunu eni mehe nanana mouwedi, la ra'uli Ai ra'aheni, “Nin wanakunu ma'aruru wake'e! Kak dernala wanakuku man mou heheni makun! Maa ida ma ne'el ida na'ahenia, ‘Ri eni Yusup anan menee!’ ”
Yesus ne'el heri onne na'ahenia, “Ya auroin mi kam hamlinu wanakunu naho'ok eniyeni: Lo'o o mamwali dokter kokkoo, ken ma'inapin o kemen

nanu! Mi raram nodi hopon Ya'u hi'i heheni. Mi mahinorok nahenia lo'o Ya amwali nabi kokkoo, wa'an rehi Ya'u hi'i ha man ri kan dodo'onnala makun lolo iknik leke eni naisa mim dederne Ya'u hi'iyedi lolo Kapernaum.
Horhorok Ainu'u panaeku eniyeni: Ri ka nadedem kokala nabi ida lolo nina leke mememen.

Derne makaniyala Ainu'u wanakunu ma namlolo eniyeni ono panaeku ma naise onne namwaliyedi nabi Elia nin lere nonolu eni. Lere onne a'am na'inelekedi anna wokelu wollo woneme raramne de roulara lape lolo noho onne na'akeme, la maeke walwalum nammori aile noho Israel.
Kade onne namlolo, maa Makromod Lalap kan hopon Elia laa maeke ida nano hi, maa hopon nala'a laa maeke walwalum ida ma aile Sarfat lolo Sidon.
Ha naisa onne namwali nabi Elisa nin lere nonolu eni haenhi. Lolo Israel ri nammori ulik yak hi'ie, maa Elisa kan hi'i wa'an ri mahaku nano hi. An hi'i wa'an Na'aman mehe, ai onne ri manin Syria.”
Man min lolo kerei raram onne na'akeme derne Nin wanakunu onneni ne, hi ra'ahan rehi.
Hi ramriri, rohi Yesus namhara kote, rodie laa wo'or kekin ma na'uranrani kota onne leke rokul lolo wo'or kekin laa yawa.
Enimaa Yesus loledi heri leken de nala'a me'e.
Yesus Nin molollo nohi hayakyaka nano ri
Horu ne, Yesus nala'a laa kota Kapernaum lolo noho Galilea. Rakan Alam Renren Warwarna An wakuku ri nammori lolo onne.
Heri man min lolo onnenihe mehe nanana mouwedi la aki'aki uluwakun derne Nina wanakukue, ono Nin wanakuku nodi molollo la nedille hi akin.
Lolo Yahudi rira kerei raram ri ida aile man hayakyak hu'uhu'ur raramne. An wakau na'ahenia,
“Heih! Yesus! Nazaret O. Om paeku inhawa noro mayai? Om mai leke mano'onyaka mayai me'e? Ya auroinedi O me'e. O penia Makromod Lalap Nin Hophopon mememen Man Moumou Dewdeweni!”
Yesus komdere na'ahenia, “Karkaramedi! Mamharedi ai raramne here!” Enime'ede hayakyak onne hi'i ri onne nalwali yawa lolo heri kalarna la idewe namharedi ai, maa kan hi'i apinpinha ai.
Heri na'akeme polletilu la ida ma ne'el ida na'ahenia, “Wanakuku eni ra'ahewi pe? Ai nodi molollo noro ke'eke'el an'anha hopon hayakyaka me'ene, hir derne rakani de ramharedi!”
Kame'ede panaeku ma na'ono Yesus Nin hini'i eni naderre nadaul lolo leke-leke ma aile lolo onne na'akeme.
Yesus hi'i wa'an ri nammori
Yesus namharedi Yahudi rira kerei ne, idewe laa Simon nin nakar. Rakanedi nakar ne, hir do'on Simon panin nakni'ir rinna manha de rapanak Yesus paku ai.
Enime'ede Yesus na'uraniyedi nin namkuru onno la nohiyedi nin kini'ir rinna manha me'e de moluwedi. Ideweni ne maeke onne namaka la na'akene hanana'an hi ra'an.
Lere na'ikeki helem eni ne, ri nodi ma nakni'ir nammori mai Yesus. Hirira apinha wo'ira aile. Enla Yesus kemenala liman hi dohodoho me'ede hir wa'an mouwedi.

Ri heruwali hayakyaka hu'uhu'ur raramne, la Yesus hopon hayakyaka namharedi hi raram here. Ramharedi ne, hir wakau ra'aheni, “Ai mauroinedi Makromod Lalap Anan O.” Maa Yesus ka nala leken wake'e hayakyaka wakunu, ono hi rauroinedi me'e Ai onne Kristus man Makromod Lalap kikanedi namwali Rai laa ewi-ewi eni.
Rakan oreki nohoropo Yesus nala'a laa onno ma namlina namkai lolo leke paharne. Heri laliwewer ranoin Ai, de maiyedi Nin miminlole, rahehe kawala Ai leke yon laa onno namehin me'e.

Enimaa Ai na'aheni, “Ya'u mai leke loikaru Lir Wawa'an man kukunohi ri hi'ihehewi Makromod Lalap nodi molollo ri man derne nakani Ai. Ende Ka'u loikaru ki mi mehe, maa loikaru leke-leke namehin haenhi. Onne penia Makromod Lalap hopon Ya'u mai noho wawan eni!”
Ende An kuli kerei laa kerei lolo noho Yudea na'akeme leke loikaru Makromod Lalap Lirna Wawa'an eni.

footnotes.text: Lolo wanakunu naho'ok eniyeni ‘o kemen’ wekel ri man minle leke Nazaret ono leke Nazaret onne namwali Yesus Nin leke haenhi.
Noho Sidon noho namehin, Yahudi ka.
